name: Token Factory OpenAI-compatible client
logic_name: Token Factory bounded HTTP and SSE adapter

test_list.description: A local loopback HTTP fixture exercises ChatModel request serialization, authenticated headers, separated reasoning, fragmented tool arguments, finish reason, cached usage, credential-safe Debug output, and exact local reservation-to-usage reconciliation.
A local loopback fixture verifies bounded Retry-After retry, models response parsing, embedding batch submission, dimension checks, and ordering by response index.
Fallback retry jitter remains within the per-attempt exponential ceiling and configured global cap.
Retry-After delta seconds take precedence over jitter and are bounded by the configured maximum.
HTTP-date Retry-After values parse with jiff and remain bounded by the configured maximum.
A local service-unavailable response is retried exactly within the configured 5xx attempt budget.
A loopback server that trickles SSE comment bytes inside the idle timeout is still stopped by the absolute request deadline.
A parsed 429 Retry-After updates the shared limiter; the next request waits only within the configured request deadline and is not dispatched when admission times out.
A synthetic 401 maps to a typed authentication failure without retaining or returning a response body that contains credential-like text.
HTTP is accepted only for loopback endpoints; remote plaintext and credential-bearing URLs are rejected.
The client reports redirect status and does not follow a cross-origin Location with configured bearer credentials.
The client rejects a provider stream that creates more distinct tool-call states than the configured cap before accepting the completion.
The opt-in Responses endpoint converts documented output-text, function-call, completion, and usage events into SDK chunks, ending on response.completed without requiring Chat Completions [DONE].
Validated assistant tool calls and their tool-role results serialize into the Responses API function_call/function_call_output item pair with the same call id.
Both OpenAI-compatible streaming endpoints fail closed when the SDK request contains no messages.
Ignored opt-in local smoke test sends one tool-capable chat request to 127.0.0.1:11434 and verifies a real streamed lookup tool call; it never contacts Token Factory.
SSE comments are ignored, multiple data lines are joined, CRLF is handled, and [DONE] is emitted as a distinct sentinel.
Every split point in a UTF-8 SSE fixture yields the same decoded event.
Generated Unicode SSE payloads retain the same event under randomized transport chunk partitions and match the eventsource-stream 0.2.3 differential oracle.
Frame and per-feed event limits reject input before parser buffers or output grow beyond configured bounds.
Malformed UTF-8 and use after parser finalization fail closed.
A dedicated counting-allocator integration test observes no allocations during warmed borrowed frame parsing and routing across CRLF, LF, and split-capable UTF-8 data.

inputs.name: chat_request
inputs.description: Validated model id, conversation, optional tools and output-token bound.

inputs.name: sse_body
inputs.description: OpenAI-compatible SSE frames, bounded by client configuration.

inputs.name: api_key
inputs.description: Explicit secret reference value injected by the composition root; never loaded from the environment by this crate.

output_description: Typed model events and provider-reported data; malformed, truncated, oversized, or unauthorized responses return typed failures without echoing response bodies or credentials.
